lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Visible as high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in distinct vertical columns on the lateral flank posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with circular blobs to form a grid-like pattern across the mid-flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear feature is visible running horizontally along the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp vertical gradient with specular highlights on the upper edge and soft shadows on the lower edge.

other_distinctive_markers: High-density distribution of small, roughly circular high-luminance spots is visible on the dorsal surface of the pectoral fin.
